title: U.S. 'Economic Outcast’ operation gains momentum as EU joins sanctions; South Korea weighs military backing
summary_full: The EU formally joined the U.S.-led sanctions campaign against Iran, while South Korea said it's weighing a military role to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
